messages:
anya: Heads up — kicking off keystore migration for eu-west1 private endpoints in ~10m. This will change the VPC endpoint policy and tighten egress sampling. Affected: GPU provisioning jobs that talk to keystore-proxy.
josh: ETA on the window? will this block warm pools / warmpool joins? :thinking_face:
ravi: Migration plan posted: https://internal.redwood/infra/keystore-migrate — brief: swap endpoint target, rotate endpoint SG, update IAM condition to require `kms:Decrypt` via new key alias.
elena: @ravi do we have a rollback if NAT egress starts dropping conntrack on nodes? last time warm pools got stuck for ~8m.
ravi: Rollback is simple: point endpoint back to old target, revert SG, re-add old IAM condition. But note: during swap there will be a ~30s window where some nodes will hit 403 from keystore and fall into provisioning retries.
anya: Important: we'll enable firewall sampling at 1000/s for the first 15m to capture any unusual denies — may add ~2% CPU on the proxy.
tim: Who's owning escalation? @infra-oncall can you be standby for 30m after rollout?
infra-oncall: I'm on standby. If we see >5% node provisioning retries for 5m I will pause the rollout.
josh: Can we pre-warm the keystore clients with new alias to avoid decrypt spikes?
ravi: We're planning a staged DNS swap: traceable by header `x-keystore-version`. Clients will do a 1-min backoff then try new alias; older clients will keep using cached tokens for ~10m.
elena: Any IAM boundary changes to watch? we need to ensure role-boundary doesn't block new key usage for infra agents.
ravi: Good call — added a conditional in the migration job to attach `iam:PassRole` when needed. Also double-checking role-boundary policies in us-east and ap-south (should be unaffected).
anya: Reminder: GPU onboarding in eu-west will be rate-limited to 10 nodes/min during the swap. Expect transient capacity shortfall for batch jobs.
josh: Noted. I'll throttle ML batch scheduler for next hour.
deploy-bot: Deployment started by ravi (keystore-migration/eu-west) — job id: dep-8743 — started at 1746239876
ravi: Step 1 complete: created new endpoint target and updated SGs. No errors in smoke test (decrypt roundtrip ok on one canary node).
anya: Good. Proceeding with DNS target swap in 2m. Re-check logs for firewall denied on proxy.
(2m later)
ravi: DNS swap done. Canaries showing `x-keystore-version: 2`.
elena: Seeing a few new 403s from node-172-44-* in warmpool. Count ~7 in last 60s. Not yet at threshold.
infra-oncall: Monitoring conntrack and NAT. conntrack usage +4% but stable. No NAT saturation signs.
josh: Batching window: dropping to 8 nodes/min just in case.
anya: Okay continue monitoring. Remember to capture pcap for any encrypted failures if they spike.
ravi: Enabling extra audit logging on keystore-proxy (sampling 1:1 for next 5m). Will push logs to retention:ephemeral-audit for triage.
infra-oncall: Alert rule created: "keystore_provision_retry_rate" if >5% for 5m -> pager to infra-oncall
deploy-bot: Audit logging toggle enabled (keystore-proxy) — trace id: audit-9922
(3m later)
elena: Retry rate at 3.8% over 5m. Most errors are `AccessDenied` with condition mismatch: looks like a few builder roles missing new key alias in IAM allow list.
ravi: Patching role mapping now — applying terraform change to add alias to `infra-builder` and `gpu-provisioner` roles. Will use canary roll.
tim: How long to propogate? need to know for scheduler.
ravi: IAM change should be effective in ~45s after apply + cache TTL of 60s.
anya: If we cross 5% while patching, pause DNS and roll back target.
(1m later)
ravi: IAM patch applied. Confirmed `infra-builder` has new key alias in policy.
elena: Errors down to 0.9% in the last minute. Nice.
infra-oncall: conntrack stable, CPU on proxy at +3% only. No further action.
anya: Moving to finalize: increase firewall sampling back to baseline, reduce audit retention to normal.
deploy-bot: Rollout complete — keystore-migration/eu-west succeeded — dep-8743 — finished at 1746240589
ravi: Will follow up with runbook update and add a note to incident binder if we want stricter role boundary gating.
anya: Thanks everyone. Postmortem lite: - Migration went green with small IAM rollback window - Throttle for GPU onboarding prevented major impact - Add explicit gating for builder roles next time :thumbsup:
josh: +1, will add scheduler flag to auto-throttle on future keystore swaps.
infra-oncall: Clearing standby, will watch for delayed issues over next 4h.
anya: Closing thread.
